messages:
Asha: Heads-up — Flannel Friday tomorrow! Bring your best plaid and snap a pic if you're in-office or remote. :tshirt: :camera:
Miguel: Love this. Is there a prize for Most Excessive Plaid? :trophy:
Lina: I call dibs on 'Most Festive Collar'. Will need coffee to power through judging. :coffee:
Ravi: Remote reporting in — can we do a quick 15-min hangout at 3pm PT to show off fits? Would be fun for the team call-in people.
Asha: Yes — 3pm PT works. I'll drop a calendar invite and a Zoom link. Also starting a photo thread here so people can post pics throughout the day.
Miguel: Ooh can PhotoBot stitch a collage after? :robot_face: @PhotoBot any time to run your magic?
PhotoBot: automated: I can generate a collage at 4:30pm PT if at least 4 photos are posted with the thread tag #flannelfriday. Reply 'yes' to confirm.
Lina: yes
Ravi: yes
Miguel: yes — adding mine tomorrow morning!
Asha: Cool. Quick poll: should we do categories — Best Plaid, Most Creative, Best Remote Background? Reply with category names you want.
Lina: Best Plaid + Most Creative + Best Quarantine Pet in Flannel (I will bribe my cat). :cat:
Miguel: Best Plaid + Funniest Accessory
Ravi: Keep it chill — Best Plaid + People's Choice (live reaction votes in the Zoom)
Asha: All right I will set those up. PRIZES: two snack boxes and a $25 merch credit. No judges bias, promise. :wink:
Lina: Snack boxes = instant sign-up.
Miguel: If anyone needs flannel suggestions, 2nd floor lost-and-found has a spare plaid shirt from last winter.
Ravi: Remote folks: post a selfie here and I'll compile a gallery so folks can still vote.
Asha: Reminder tomorrow AM: drop a photo here. We'll close submissions at 4pm PT and PhotoBot will make the collage at 4:30pm.
Miguel: Also — if you're shy, post a close-up of the pattern only. No pressure. :grin:
Lina: Can't wait. This will be a nice break. :sparkles:
Ravi: See you all (virtually) tomorrow at 3pm!
PhotoBot: automated: noted — scheduled collage at 4:30pm PT. Please include the hashtag #flannelfriday in your posts so I can find them.
